title: Thai Serrano Ham Wrap
description: A fusion of Thai and Mexican flavors, this wrap combines spicy serrano ham with warm, crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Warm the flour wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds.
Slice the cucumber, carrot, and bell pepper into thin strips.
Cut the serrano ham into thin strips.
Assemble the wrap by placing the ham, vegetables, and cilantro in the center of the wrap.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
Cut the wrap in half and serve immediately.
